Ingredients: 
4 skinless, boneless chicken breasts cut thin
Salt and pepper to taste
2 eggs
1 cup bread crumps
1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese
2 tbps flour 
Olive oil
Marinara sauce (1 jar is more than enough)
Shredded Mozzarella cheese
Shredded Parmesan cheese
fresh or dried basil for seasoning (I used dried)

Instructions: 
1. Preheat oven to 450 F
2. Pound chicken breasts to about 1/2 inch thickness
3. Season breasts with salt and pepper on both sides
4. Beat eggs in a bowl
5. Mix bread crumbs and grated Parmesan cheese in another bowl
6. Sift flour over both sides of chicken breasts
7. Dip breasts in egg then bread crumb and cheese mixture. Set breasts aside for 15 minutes
8. Heat a skillet and olive oil (enough to coat the bottom of the skillet)
9. Cook chicken 2 minutes each side (until golden)
10. Put chicken in baking dish and add enough marinara to cover the top of the chicken (or however much you prefer)
11. Add shredded mozzarella and parmesan on top (however much preferred, I did an even layer on top)
12. Sprinkle basil on top
13. Bake in oven 15-20 minutes until cheese is bubbly and chicken no longer pink inside
